commands.name: update
commands.description: Update one property across DataHub entities.

options.name: --profile
options.description: Shared Reimaginate CLI profile to use for this command.

options.name: --url
options.description: DataHub CLI endpoint URL for this command.

options.name: --tenant
options.description: Microsoft Entra tenant id for this command.

options.name: --scope
options.description: DataHub API delegated scope for this command.

options.name: --output
options.description: Output format: table, json, ndjson, or tsv.

options.name: --where
options.description: DataHub query selecting entities to update.

options.name: --entity-type
options.description: Entity type for explicit id updates.

options.name: --ids
options.description: Entity ids to update.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip confirmation prompt. [default: False]

options.name: --silent
options.description: Patch without updating last updated timestamps. [default: False]

options.name: --notify-agents
options.description: Dispatch notifications to agents. [default: False]

options.name: --continue
options.description: Continue on failure. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview matched entities and proposed values without applying updates. [default: False]

arguments.name: VALUE
arguments.description: Value to set. Parsed as JSON when valid; otherwise treated as a string.
